dedupe_keys.name: vectorized dataset of silted land formed by check dams on the chinese loess plateau

description: Vectorized dataset of silted land formed by check dams on the Chinese Loess Plateau is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yi Zeng et al. Check dams on the Chinese Loess Plateau (CLP) have captured billions of tons of eroded sediment, substantially reducing sediment load in the Yellow River. However, uncertainties persist regarding the precise sediment capture and the role of these dams in Yellow River flow and sediment dynamics due to the lack of available spatial distribution datasets. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2024. Formats: Shapefile. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
